Name: Modest Maps Cellar
Author: InkubusMods
Description:
[b][size=3]UPDATED FOR STARDEW VALLEY 1.6[/size][/b]

REQUIRES:
[list]
[*]SMAPI
[*]Content patcher
[*]Yep. [i]That's all[/i].
[/list]

OVERVIEW:
The Modest Cellar Map is a redesigned basement, meant to capitalize on the space provided with the vanilla map, with a few tweaks here and there for added support.


The Cellar includes added perks and space.
[list]
[*]Slightly Larger space.
[*]Wall lights for better ambience. 
[*]A built in kitchen.
[*]A wooden landing to place furniture.
[/list]

SIDE NOTES:
[list]
[*]If you like my work or have found an issue, I'd love for you to let me know in the POSTS! This is the first mod I've ever posted to the nexus, or put so much effort into, so I'd appreciate the support!
[/list]
MANUAL INSTALLATION:
Download the file.
Extract the Folder.
Put said folder into:
﻿Steam>Steamapps>Common>StardewValley>Mods.
Load with SMAPI.
Enjoy.

Downloads.Description: Updated mod for 1.6 support, and added a landing to decorate with furniture.
